sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, scientists are racing to make a vaccine against the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 今天，科学家们正在竞相研发针对冠状病毒的疫苗。

sentences.en: Katrin Benholdt, on how that race is not just about creating the vaccine, but about which country will own it.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳·本霍尔特将讲述这场竞赛不仅关乎疫苗的研发，更关乎哪个国家将拥有它。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月1日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, at the end of December, these scientists around the world were basically looking at this outbreak of this strange, mysterious illness in Wuhan, China.
sentences.zh: 12月底，世界各地的科学家基本上都在关注中国武汉爆发的这种奇怪而神秘的疾病。

sentences.en: And at this time, the media, especially the Western media, isn't really paying attention to this thing yet.
sentences.zh: 当时，媒体，尤其是西方媒体，还没有真正关注这件事。

sentences.en: Wildfire emergency in Southeast Australia.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚东南部的森林大火紧急状态。

sentences.en: It was killed in U.S.
sentences.zh: 他在美国被杀。

sentences.en: air strikes in Iraq.
sentences.zh: 在伊拉克的空袭中。

sentences.en: Sending the articles of impeachment over to the Senate.
sentences.zh: 将弹劾条款提交给参议院。

sentences.en: But scientists are already beginning to puzzle through what this could be.
sentences.zh: 但科学家们已经开始琢磨这到底是什么了。

sentences.en: It seemed like a respiratory thing.
sentences.zh: 这看起来像是一种呼吸道疾病。

sentences.en: It reminded some of them of diseases like MERS or SARS and some of these other things that have come along in recent years.
sentences.zh: 它让一些人想起了近年来出现的MERS或SARS等疾病。

sentences.en: But at this stage, they're just kind of corresponding with each other on their social media, saying, hey, what is this thing?
sentences.zh: 但在现阶段，他们只是在社交媒体上互相交流，问：嘿，这是什么东西？

sentences.en: And that's how this story begins for one doctor based in Germany, Lydia Ostfogels.
sentences.zh: 这就是故事对一位身在德国的医生莉迪亚·奥斯特福格尔斯来说的开始方式。
zh_words: 莉迪亚·奥斯特福格尔斯来说

sentences.en: Hi, Lydia.
sentences.zh: 你好，莉迪亚。

sentences.en: Bonjour.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: I don't know what language to speak to you, Lydia.
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚，我不知道该用什么语言和你交流。

sentences.en: This is Katrin.
sentences.zh: 我是卡特琳。

sentences.en: And Katrin, who is Lydia Ostfogels?
sentences.zh: 卡特琳，莉迪亚·奥斯特福格尔斯是谁？
zh_words: 莉迪亚·奥斯特福格尔斯

sentences.en: This is good.
sentences.zh: 这样很好。

sentences.en: English is good.
sentences.zh: 英语很好。

sentences.en: So Lydia works for this German company called CuroVac.
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚在一家名为CuroVac的德国公司工作。

sentences.en: They work on vaccines as well as cancer treatments, and they do molecular therapies.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅研究疫苗，还研究癌症治疗，并从事分子疗法。

sentences.en: And take me back to the moment when you first heard about this new virus.
sentences.zh: 带我回到你第一次听说这种新病毒的时刻。

sentences.en: Do you remember that moment?
sentences.zh: 你还记得那个时刻吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, because, of course, on my social media...
sentences.zh: 记得，因为当然，在我的社交媒体上……

sentences.en: At the end of her Christmas holiday, Lydia was seeing these posts.
sentences.zh: 圣诞假期结束时，莉迪亚看到了这些帖子。

sentences.en: And she was wondering if this was maybe something she and her team could work on.
sentences.zh: 她当时在想，这是否可能是她和她的团队可以研究的东西。

sentences.en: And you think like, oh, what is this?
sentences.zh: 你会想，哦，这是什么？

sentences.en: What is happening there?
sentences.zh: 那里发生了什么？

sentences.en: Is that something that could work on, could make a vaccine on and do...
sentences.zh: 这是我们可以研究的东西吗？可以制造疫苗并进行……

sentences.en: But at that stage, she couldn't.
sentences.zh: 但在那个阶段，她还不能。

sentences.en: Because she didn't have the genetic sequencing of this virus.
sentences.zh: 因为她没有这种病毒的基因序列。

sentences.en: And actually, the same was true for scientists around the world who were wondering the same thing.
sentences.zh: 事实上，世界各地有同样疑问的科学家们也是如此。

sentences.en: And so they were all kind of just wondering and waiting.
sentences.zh: 所以他们都在观望和等待。

sentences.en: And then on January 10th, the sequencing was actually published by these Chinese scientists who put it on a public page for basically all the world scientists to see.
sentences.zh: 1月10日，中国科学家将序列发布在一个公共页面上，基本上让全世界的科学家都能看到。

sentences.en: So I got the message like, OK, we have a sequence so we can go ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以我收到了消息，好的，我们有了序列，可以开始了。

sentences.en: This is kind of when the clock starts ticking.
sentences.zh: 这就是时钟开始滴答作响的时候。

sentences.en: But it's not a race yet.
sentences.zh: 但这还不是一场竞赛。

sentences.en: I mean, at that moment, it was not a pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在那一刻，它还不是一场大流行病。

sentences.en: It was an outbreak in China.
sentences.zh: 这只是中国的一次疫情爆发。

sentences.en: At this point, they didn't actually exactly know what they were racing againSt.
sentences.zh: 此时，他们实际上并不确切知道自己在与什么竞争。

sentences.en: So it was still kind of just a regular process.
sentences.zh: 所以这仍然只是一个常规过程。

sentences.en: They draw up a presentation.
sentences.zh: 他们起草了一份演示文稿。

sentences.en: So we were preparing these slides to present to say, OK, this is something we could do and we think it's useful that we would do it.
sentences.zh: 我们准备了这些幻灯片来展示，说，好的，这是我们可以做的事情，我们认为这样做是有用的。

sentences.en: She was creating the slides for this presentation.
sentences.zh: 她正在为这次演示制作幻灯片。

sentences.en: And as she started, there was literally one death, one known death in China.
sentences.zh: 当她开始时，中国确实只有一例已知的死亡病例。

sentences.en: And by the time that we went to the meeting with the management, each day almost we had to update the number of case fatalities.
sentences.zh: 当我们去参加管理层会议时，几乎每天我们都必须更新死亡病例的数量。

sentences.en: And this was, I mean, this is something really I remember very well that, OK, additional people died.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我记忆犹新，好的，又有人去世了。

sentences.en: Well, this is virus.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是病毒。

sentences.en: And that's only two and a half months ago.
sentences.zh: 那才仅仅是两个半月前的事。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, that was January.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，那是1月。

sentences.en: Eventually, management greenlighted the project.
sentences.zh: 最终，管理层批准了该项目。

sentences.en: This is in late January.
sentences.zh: 那是在1月下旬。

sentences.en: The funding came through.
sentences.zh: 资金到位了。

sentences.en: So let's get going.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始吧。

sentences.en: And that's when they really got to work.
sentences.zh: 那时他们才真正开始工作。

sentences.en: And what did that work look like in the beginning?
sentences.zh: 起初的工作是什么样的？

sentences.en: What does it mean to create from scratch a vaccine?
sentences.zh: 从零开始研制疫苗意味着什么？

sentences.en: Remember, basically what you're trying to achieve with a vaccine is you want to create something that mimics the pathogen, the virus.
sentences.zh: 记住，你通过疫苗想要实现的目标基本上是创造出一种模拟病原体（即病毒）的东西。

sentences.en: And you want to inject that into a healthy body so that that healthy body can read that information,
sentences.zh: 你想把它注入健康的身体，这样健康的身体就能读取这些信息，

sentences.en: understand what the pathogen looks like and form antibodies to fight it and neutralize it.
sentences.zh: 了解病原体的样子，并形成抗体来对抗和中和它。

sentences.en: And I mean, you have surely seen these pictures of the virus that everybody in the news and so on is always showing with this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你肯定看过新闻里大家一直在展示的这种病毒图片。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like this ball with these things that that stick out of it.
sentences.zh: 就像一个球，上面长着一些突起物。

sentences.en: Basically, this cute little ball with spikes.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就是一个带有刺的可爱小球。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's actually the proteins that you have to neutralize with antibodies to fight the virus.
sentences.zh: 而这实际上就是你必须用抗体来中和以对抗病毒的蛋白质。

sentences.en: And that's what you actually ask the cells of the of the human body to make.
sentences.zh: 这就是你要求人体细胞去制造的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, it's the spikes, not actually the ball that are bad.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是那些刺，而不是球体本身有害。

sentences.en: So this whole project is about coming up with a vaccine that will enter the body, prompt an immune response, and that response will somehow de-spike the spikes of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 所以整个项目的目标是研制出一种疫苗，进入人体后激发免疫反应，这种反应将以某种方式去除冠状病毒的刺。

sentences.en: That's the idea.
sentences.zh: 这就是思路。

sentences.en: We're now in February.
sentences.zh: 现在是2月了。

sentences.en: And as they're working on this.
sentences.zh: 当他们正在研究这个的时候。

sentences.en: Well, over in the Philippines, the first coronavirus death outside of China on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 在菲律宾，周日出现了中国境外首例冠状病毒死亡病例。

sentences.en: The second death from coronavirus outside of mainland China.
sentences.zh: 中国大陆以外的第二例冠状病毒死亡病例。

sentences.en: Hong Kong health officials saying a 39-year-old...
sentences.zh: 香港卫生官员称一名39岁的……

sentences.en: The potentially deadly coronavirus has turned up in a new country this morning.
sentences.zh: 这种潜在的致命冠状病毒今天早上出现在了一个新的国家。

sentences.en: Belgium reported its first case.
sentences.zh: 比利时报告了首例病例。

sentences.en: Coronavirus is beginning to spread across the world.
sentences.zh: 冠状病毒开始在世界各地蔓延。

sentences.en: And CuroVac puts this vaccine development ahead of any other projects.
sentences.zh: CuroVac将这种疫苗的研发置于所有其他项目之上。

sentences.en: So this is now becoming a major priority within this company.
sentences.zh: 所以这现在成了公司内部的一个主要优先事项。

sentences.en: This is an urgent project.
sentences.zh: 这是一个紧急项目。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they're not the only ones.
sentences.zh: 而且他们不是唯一的一家。

sentences.en: You've got companies all over the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地都有这样的公司。

sentences.en: In China, in the U.S., across Europe.
sentences.zh: 在中国、美国、欧洲各地。

sentences.en: Everybody is now looking at this as a high priority.
sentences.zh: 每个人现在都将其视为重中之重。

sentences.en: So Lydia and her team basically are working on a number of prospective vaccines.
sentences.zh: 所以莉迪亚和她的团队基本上正在研究多种潜在疫苗。

sentences.en: They have these different combinations that they're trying out.
sentences.zh: 他们有不同的组合正在尝试。

sentences.en: This one, this one, this one, this one.
sentences.zh: 这个，这个，这个，这个。

sentences.en: And in early March, they're beginning to actually inject them into mice to see what the effect is.
sentences.zh: 3月初，他们开始将它们注入小鼠体内，看看效果如何。

sentences.en: As we always say, mice are not men.
sentences.zh: 正如我们常说的，小鼠不是人类。

sentences.en: If something doesn't work in mice, then you don't even have to test it in men.
sentences.zh: 如果某种东西在小鼠身上不起作用，那么你甚至不需要在人类身上进行测试。

sentences.en: They narrow it down.
sentences.zh: 他们缩小了范围。

sentences.en: In the beginning, we had seven.
sentences.zh: 起初，我们有七种。

sentences.en: And then we down-selected to four.
sentences.zh: 然后我们筛选剩下四种。

sentences.en: And then we further down-selected to two.
sentences.zh: 然后我们进一步筛选剩下两种。

sentences.en: Two sort of most promising prospective vaccines.
sentences.zh: 两种最有希望的候选疫苗。

sentences.en: And this is a time when the cases are spiking in Italy, the number of deaths arising, including in Germany, where the lab is based.
sentences.zh: 当时意大利的病例激增，死亡人数上升，包括实验室所在的德国也是如此。

sentences.en: And they're going up in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且在美国也在上升。

sentences.en: as well.
sentences.zh: 同样如此。

sentences.en: So this is basically now in Lydia's backyard.
sentences.zh: 所以这基本上已经到了莉迪亚的家门口。

sentences.en: It's now in her own backyard.
sentences.zh: 现在就在她自己的家门口。

sentences.en: Everybody is working from morning to evening.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在从早到晚地工作。

sentences.en: And then having, I mean, still trying to get some sleep because it's not a sprint.
sentences.zh: 然后，我的意思是，仍然试图争取一些睡眠，因为这不是短跑。

sentences.en: It's a marathon.
sentences.zh: 这是一场马拉松。

sentences.en: We are not yet there.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有到达终点。

sentences.en: So we should not be exhausted now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在不应该精疲力竭。

sentences.en: She's being told by the government to work remotely.
sentences.zh: 政府告诉她要远程办公。

sentences.en: She has to sort of direct this team of lab scientists who are still going into the lab, working carefully and trying to practice social distancing.
sentences.zh: 她必须指挥这支实验室科学家团队，他们仍然在进入实验室，小心工作并试图保持社交距离。

sentences.en: It is a non-stop phone call from morning to evening.
sentences.zh: 从早到晚电话不断。

sentences.en: So you have to struggle to find the time to run to the kitchen to get something to eat.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须挣扎着找时间跑去厨房吃点东西。

sentences.en: It's logistically incredibly difficult, but it's also emotionally incredibly straining.
sentences.zh: 这在后勤上极其困难，但在情感上也极其紧张。

sentences.en: She said every time she watches the news, it fills her with dread.
sentences.zh: 她说每次看新闻，她都感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And I see, ah, compared to yesterday, now X people have died and X people are infected.
sentences.zh: 我看到，啊，与昨天相比，现在又有X人死亡，X人感染。

sentences.en: I mean, just to tell you, I never have nightmares.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我从来不做噩梦。

sentences.en: But now recently I was dreaming that I was sitting with my preclinical colleague and then there was a flock of bats that flew over our heads.
sentences.zh: 但最近我梦见我和临床前同事坐在一起，然后一群蝙蝠从我们头顶飞过。

sentences.en: And then I woke up and I was thinking, no, am I really dreaming about this now and that I'm going to vaccinate bats too?
sentences.zh: 然后我醒了，心想，不，我真的在梦到这个吗？我还要给蝙蝠接种疫苗吗？

sentences.en: And so the sheer strain and the stress of this work in the circumstances of an actual outbreak in her own country is intense.
sentences.zh: 所以，在自己国家疫情爆发的情况下，这种工作的巨大压力和紧张感是极其强烈的。

sentences.en: I mean, it must be tough.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一定很艰难。

sentences.en: I mean, you're sort of living and as you just revealed, dreaming this.
sentences.zh: 你正在经历这一切，正如你刚才所透露的，甚至在梦中也是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I have to imagine that that comes with this sort of feeling of enormous responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我想这一定伴随着一种巨大的责任感。

sentences.en: I mean, we've talked to a lot of doctors recently who've had very vulnerable moments, broken down, crying in hospitals, you know, with a flood of patients coming in,
sentences.zh: 我们最近采访了很多医生，他们有过非常脆弱的时刻，在医院里崩溃、哭泣，你知道，随着大量病人的涌入，

sentences.en: some of whom they can't help.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人他们无法救治。

sentences.en: I mean, is there anything like that happening with your colleagues?
sentences.zh: 你的同事们有发生过类似的事情吗？

sentences.en: As far as I know, not.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，没有。

sentences.en: And I think the difference is that if you see a patient coming in that you know you will not be able to save because he is already so sick and you cannot save him and you see him dying under your hands,
sentences.zh: 我认为区别在于，如果你看到一个病人进来，你知道你无法挽救他，因为他已经病得太重了，你无法救他，你看着他在你手中死去，

sentences.en: that's an enormous frustration.
sentences.zh: 那是一种巨大的挫败感。

sentences.en: But our part of the work is to bring something to prevent that anybody ever has to live this.
sentences.zh: 但我们工作的一部分是带来某种东西，防止任何人必须经历这些。

sentences.en: So that's not the same kind of emotional pressure, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这并不是同一种情感压力。

sentences.en: I mean, we have the pressure that we have to go quick because we have potentially something that can save this from happening.
sentences.zh: 我们面临的压力是我们必须快点，因为我们可能拥有可以阻止这种情况发生的东西。

sentences.en: But we are building something that will give hope to the people.
sentences.zh: 但我们正在建立的东西将给人们带来希望。

sentences.en: Katrin, you mentioned that Lydia and her team are testing potential vaccines in mice.
sentences.zh: 卡特琳，你提到莉迪亚和她的团队正在小鼠身上测试潜在疫苗。

sentences.en: But how soon do they expect that they would have a final vaccine ready for humans?
sentences.zh: 但他们预计多久能准备好最终的人用疫苗？

sentences.en: So the next very important step will be to actually test this thing in clinical trials, meaning injecting it into actual humans.
sentences.zh: 下一个非常重要的步骤是在临床试验中测试这种东西，也就是将其注入真正的人类体内。

sentences.en: And at the moment, they're sort of hopeful that the human trials can begin in June or July.
sentences.zh: 目前，他们希望能在6月或7月开始人体试验。

sentences.en: And that, Lydia says, would put them on track for developing an actual vaccine that can be used for mass consumption early next year, which kind of sounds far away,
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚说，这将使他们有望在明年年初开发出可供大众使用的疫苗，这听起来似乎很遥远，

sentences.en: but is incredibly faSt.
sentences.zh: 但实际上速度极快。

sentences.en: Normally, vaccines can take like a decade, even 15 years to develop.

sentences.en: The White House basically invites two dozen companies to a roundtable discussion about the prospects of developing a vaccine against COVID-19, the coronavirus.

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: And we have the wherewithal to manufacture it, although we would like some additional help on our largest GNP4 facility.

sentences.en: Again, we appreciate the opportunity to be here today.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢今天能有这个机会来到这里。

sentences.en: And thank you very much.

sentences.en: Thank you very much.

sentences.en: Appreciate it.

sentences.en: ambassador to Germany, Richard Grinnell, wrote on Twitter, the Welt story was wrong.

sentences.zh: 他们试图达成什么目的？

sentences.zh: 这场竞赛背后是一个相当残酷但又相当简单的现实。

sentences.zh: 因此，谁先开发出来，谁就会试图确保自己的人民能优先获得。

sentences.en: So those who develop it first will try to ensure that their own people are first in line for it.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论是在德国、中国还是美国，谁在国家层面上控制了这家公司，谁就控制了疫苗的早期分配。

sentences.en: So whoever controls the company nationally controls that early distribution of the vaccine, whether that's Germany or China or the United States.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: it was obliged at the time by its own government to service the Australian market first before honoring export orders to the United States and other countries.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，猪流感疫苗供不应求。

sentences.en: Well, the World Health Organization says there's not enough swine flu vaccine for everyone.

sentences.en: That really rattled the United States.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上引发了愤怒。

sentences.en: It kind of spurred this outrage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢主席先生，感谢您召开这次重要的听证会。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, Mr. Chairman, and thank you for convening this important hearing.
